title: Clean Mid-Mod Charmer - Heated, Fenced Pool!
description:
Welcome to your new favorite getaway! This mid-century modern wonderland is packed with personality, comfort, and plenty of room for everyone - 5 bedrooms, 4 full bathrooms, a queen-size pull-out couch. The outdoor space features a heated and fenced (safety for the little ones!) pool, a covered patio with fireplace & TV, outdoor garden seating, wet bar, and BBQ. There's lots fun to be had with the ping pong table, Galaga arcade game, games, toys, retro decor & 5 tv's throughout the home.

 The space 
The property is 5 bedrooms/4 full bathrooms total: 4 bedroom/3 bathroom in the main house and 1 bedroom/1 bathroom in the attached mother-in-law suite.

Bedroom 1 - King Bed, En Suite Bathroom
Bedroom 2 - Queen Bed
Bedroom 3 - Queen Bed
Bedroom 4 - King Bed
Bedroom 5 - Queen Bed, En Suite Bathroom (in MIL suite)

TPT # 21487526
AZ STR LIC # 311240

 Guest access 
Garage keypad code will be given to you on check-in day when the house is ready for you.

 Other things to note 
This house is in a charming neighborhood just north of historic Downtown Chandler, with its restaurants, bars, and shops. It's also near the Chandler Mall, Price Corridor, and 101 Freeway.
